name: LawTester
description: Prescribe and apply deformations of an interaction in terms of local mutual displacements and rotations. The loading path is specified either using path<LawTester.path> (as sequence of 6-vectors containing generalized displacements $u_x$, $u_y$, $u_z$, $\phi_x$, $\phi_y$, $\phi_z$) or...

attributes.name: disPath
attributes.description: Loading path, where each Vector3 contains desired normal displacement and two components of the shear displacement (in local coordinate system, which is being tracked automatically. If shorter than

attributes.name: displIsRel
attributes.description: Whether displacement values in *disPath* are normalized by reference contact length (r1+r2 for 2 spheres).

attributes.name: doneHook
attributes.description: Python command (as string) to run when end of the path is achieved. If empty, the engine will be set

attributes.name: hooks
attributes.description: Python commands to be run when the corresponding point in path is reached, before doing other things in that particular step. See also

attributes.name: idWeight
attributes.description: Float, usually ∈〈0,1〉, determining on how are displacements distributed between particles (0 for id1, 1 for id2); intermediate values will apply respective part to each of them. This parameter is ignored with 6-DoFs

attributes.name: pathSteps
attributes.description: Step number for corresponding values in

attributes.name: refLength
attributes.description: Reference contact length, for rendering only.

attributes.name: renderLength
attributes.description: Characteristic length for the purposes of rendering, set equal to the smaller radius.

attributes.name: rotPath
attributes.description: Rotational components of the loading path, where each item contains torsion and two bending rotations in local coordinates. If shorter than

attributes.name: rotWeight
attributes.description: Float ∈〈0,1〉 determining whether shear displacement is applied as rotation or displacement on arc (0 is displacement-only, 1 is rotation-only). Not effective when mutual rotation is specified.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Step number in which this engine is active; determines position in path, using pathSteps.

attributes.name: trsf
attributes.description: Transformation matrix for the local coordinate system. |yupdate|

attributes.name: uGeom
attributes.description: Current generalized displacements (3 displacements, 3 rotations), as stored in the interation itself. They should corredpond to

attributes.name: uTest
attributes.description: Current generalized displacements (3 displacements, 3 rotations), as they should be according to this

attributes.name: uuPrev
attributes.description: Generalized displacement values reached in the previous step, for knowing which increment to apply in the current step.
